Between the edge of the carriageway and the left-hand verge

To improve fuel consumption

Switch off the engine and engage the parking brake
Check the fuel level to see if there is a leak

40 Minutes
45 Minutes

Driving on a steep downhill gradient

Pump the brake pedal quickly to build up pressure

Ensure the fuel cap is fitted with a secure, locking device and a good seal
Never fill the tank more than half full
Always park in unlit areas when the tank is full

Leave it until you change vehicles
Remove it immediately
Keep it for five years

The clutch will automatically disengage
The turbocharger will stop spinning

The rear of the vehicle swinging out during a turn

Driving on a private site not open to the public

Driving closer to the vehicle in front

56 Hours
60 Hours

bank.question: When planning a route for a large goods vehicle, what information is most important to check on a specialist map?

The locations of all roadside cafes
The history of the local landmarks

To prevent the engine from over-revving in low gears

To ensure the vehicle stays in the correct lane

bank.question: How does overloading your vehicle affect its handling?

It makes the vehicle more stable in high winds

bank.question: When should a driver carry out a walkaround check on their vehicle?

Only when the vehicle is being serviced by a mechanic
Whenever the driver changes their route

It improves the vehicle's braking efficiency
It increases fuel consumption

Use two frayed straps instead of one good one
